{{Quote|My transmissions would interfere with their current technologies, so I must refrain from broadcasting until they develop further: approximately four thousand local system revolutions.|Lomasigaro-K|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Lomasigaro-K''' was a [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] research [[Droid/Legends|droid]] dispatched by the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Gray Secant]]'' to study the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. Accompanied by a squad of Gree battle droids, it refrained from transmitting in order to not interfere with the native [[Voss (species)|Voss]] and [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak's]] technological advancement.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
